thread:
jordan: Heads up — customer NovaPlay redeemed a promo via our SSO flow and got a confirmation email that shows +$500 credits, but their account balance in the UI and the usage API is still 0. Org: nova-play-prod (org_id: org_0x9efc). Redeem txn: red_0a1b2c. Customer email: support@novaplay.com. They are blocked from running jobs. Can someone triage?

billing-bot: [auto] Redeem webhook received 2024-11-02T13:12:10Z, status: delivered to /hooks/grants-consumer (200).

sam: Can you paste the webhook payload we received and any ledger apply logs? Also account_id if you have it.

jordan: payload we got from provider (sanitized):
```json
{"grant_id":"g_9a7b","external_code":"PROMO-NOVAPLAYS-2024","amount":50000,"currency":"USD","external_org":"nova_play_ext","user_email":"support@novaplay.com","redeemed_at":"2024-11-02T13:11:59Z"}
```
Ledger consumer log for the same timeframe:
```
[2024-11-02T13:12:11Z] grants-consumer INFO received grant g_9a7b for external_org=nova_play_ext
[2024-11-02T13:12:11Z] ledger.apply INFO attempting apply -> lookup mapping for external_org=nova_play_ext
[2024-11-02T13:12:11Z] ledger.apply WARN mapping not found, fallback_org=org_test_staging, writing to staging_ledger id=stg_led_54
[2024-11-02T13:12:12Z] ledger.apply INFO write complete -> entry_id=stg_entry_987, applied_to=stg_org_test_staging
```

nate: Hmm — logs show the grant landed in staging_ledger (stg_entry_987) and mapped to stg_org_test_staging. That would explain why nova-play-prod stayed at 0. Do we have a mapping row for external_org=nova_play_ext pointing to org_0x9efc?

elaine: I pulled grants_mapping table: there is no row for nova_play_ext in prod. There is an old staging mapping for the legacy test external id. Also note the incoming webhook had header `X-Env: staging` (likely from the SSO redirect in the customer flow). It seems the redirect flow is still pointing to a staging callback for some SSO providers.

sam: That matches. The webhook consumer currently uses (external_org -> internal_org) lookup and falls back to a default staging org when not found. The fallback behavior is intended for retries but is dangerous for production redeems. We should stop falling back and surface a hard error when environment header mismatches.

jordan: I've opened a support ticket CS-4829 and notified NovaPlay. Customer asked for immediate credit so their jobs can run.

diana-support: I manually credited org_0x9efc for +50000 units via internal ledger admin:
```
API: POST /internal/ledger/v1/credits
body: {"org_id":"org_0x9efc","amount":50000,"reason":"manual-credit:CS-4829 redeem fix"}
response: {"status":"ok","entry_id":"prod_entry_246"}
```
Customer confirmed balance updated a few minutes ago. I emailed them and set expectation that we will follow up with a permanent fix.

sam: TL;DR root cause: SSO/redeem flow used a staging callback URL (header X-Env: staging) so the grants consumer wrote to staging ledger because mapping wasn't found for the external_org. Immediate remediations: 1) Add a guard to reject grant webhooks that contain X-Env != prod for prod endpoints (patch pushed), 2) Add a pre-check that refuses fallback-to-staging on missing mapping, 3) Add alerting on grants writing to non-prod ledgers.

elaine: Patch deployed to grants-consumer and ledger-adapter (INF-2314). I also added a data migration task to add proper mapping for nova_play_ext -> org_0x9efc to avoid replays re-mapping to staging.

jordan: Customer confirmed jobs are now running. Closing immediate loop — please include a short postmortem in CS-4829 and link to infra ticket INF-2314. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
